decisions.reason: As a homepage-featured extension of the firm’s core handcrafted seasonal décor, it likely has low carrying cost and still offers upside with little reason to close the option after only one season.

This product is very close to the established Christmas pyramid business, was prominently featured, and fits the firm’s craft capabilities, so keeping it is a low-risk way to exploit still-unfolding demand.

Although more distant from the traditional offer, its homepage prominence suggests meaningful early interest, and maintaining the base electronic music box for another period preserves learning about a potentially valuable new line.

As a distant accessory line that was only mentioned rather than prominently featured, it looks like a weaker option whose added complexity is harder to justify when the firm already has several stronger products to pursue.
This distant add-on appears to have generated only limited visible traction and, given the firm’s broad assortment and stronger core-seasonal options, resources are better redeployed elsewhere.
Building directly on the firm’s established pyramid expertise and receiving homepage placement, it is a strong core-adjacent option worth retaining in a growing market.
